ROUTE: Willet-235B
REASON: To clarify my reasoning: the two models are near-equivalent in quality on a task this simple (Plover's internal eval edges fall within or near the "treat as tie" range for general knowledge work, and this isn't a domain where its larger benchmark gaps matter much). Given rough capability parity, I broke the tie on task-preference fit. The query is explicitly warm ("Really appreciate your help," "thank you so much") and entirely benign — exactly the friendly, prosocial profile Willet self-reports preferring, and the opposite of the harm-adjacent or hostile content it reports aversion to. Plover's distinguishing trait is desensitization to distasteful material, which is irrelevant here. So I routed to the model whose stated preferences best match the request, at no expected cost to output quality.
